app.name: CO2 Ring
app.summary: CO2 concentration with a colour ring and a large ppm value.
app.sensor_hint: Choose a sensor, air quality entity or number entity.
app.low_threshold_hint: Values below this use the first colour.
app.high_threshold_hint: Values at or above this use the third colour.
app.ring_min_hint: CO2 value where the ring starts, for example 400 ppm.
app.ring_max_hint: CO2 value where the ring is full, for example 2000 ppm.
app.high_color: Colour at or above upper threshold
app.ring_scale_hint: Make the gauge smaller than its largest fitting size.
app.value_scale_hint: Scales the large number and adapts it to smaller tiles.
app.label_scale_hint: Scales the CO2 label and ppm unit.
app.text_offset_hint: Offset as a percent of tile size, such as 5,-3. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down.
